question.text: What does hands-free mean, and which devices are covered?

answer.text: Iowa's hands-free rule forbids holding a phone or manually operating it while driving. Calls, texts and dialing require hands-free use or voice activation; video streaming and video calls remain prohibited even when voice-operated. Electronic devices include phones, personal digital assistants, tablets, gaming devices and laptops.
